## C11 Partial h300 root-method experiment

The operator readback contains 28 terminal tasks of the first 60-task block. One task was running and 31 were pending. The receipt join matched all terminal rows to Slurm and confirmed that their worker affinity exposed the prescribed number of distinct physical cores. The five memory-guard stops have zero deltas for the reported cgroup OOM-kill and failure counters. The two tasks with error status returned no usable incumbent. Their underlying termination codes require the full receipts or native log tails.
